title: Mixed Event — Wonder Magical Showtime! — Episode4 The Star's Big Speech!

meta.Event Outline: Phoenix Wonderland is faced with a transformation at the hands of Emu's brothers to appeal to the young adult crowd. In order to make sure it stays a place that makes everyone smile, Wonderlands×Showtime prepares a new show. In time, the curtain rises on a show unlike any other!

rows.Line: Wonder Stage
se_event_wonders_2021_009

rows.Speaker: Cast
rows.Line:
There's so many people here!
And it's not just the stage troupes either. Aren't some regular staff members here too...?

rows.Speaker: Staff
rows.Line:
It was in the script, right?
This show needs everyone, including the park staff.

rows.Speaker: Cast
rows.Line:
Hm?
Oh, right. They're supposed to...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Comrades...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Thank you for gathering here at the Wonder Stage today. You have our solemn gratitude!

rows.Speaker: Cast
rows.Line: Hm? Is he from the Wonder Stage?

rows.Speaker: Cast
rows.Line:
Yeah, I think so.
His name's...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Allow me to introduce myself! My name is...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Tenma, written as “soaring pegasus”! Tsukasa, meaning to govern! I am Tsukasa Tenma, the soaring pegasus born to rule the showbiz world!

rows.Speaker: Cast & Staff
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
A-Are you sure about this?!
They all look completely dumbfounded...!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We'll just have to wait and see.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: That's just Tsukasa for you!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I'm sure that all of you are already aware of this fact, but to reiterate, the fate of Phoenix Wonderland currently hangs in the balance!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: One path involves attracting younger guests to improve this park's attendance figures so that this park will survive as a business!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: The other path, our plan, involves making this park a welcoming place for guests of all ages and one that can make everyone who visits smile!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I understand that a proper business plan is still necessary for this park to stay afloat. However, shows are also elixirs for making people grin from ear to ear...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Age and gender do not matter. It doesn't matter if you're an alien from outer space who speaks an incomprehensible language!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: At the very least, I want my show to make everybody smile!!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: And this park is a place that made so many people smile. It's a place that's full of precious memories.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: “A place that can make everyone smile.” That is why so many people used to visit! That is what everybody loved about Phoenix Wonderland!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
That is why I'm doing this show!
To prove that this park is still just that!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We don't have to choose between this park being loved and this park attracting as many guests as it can!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: If we can put on a show that makes absolutely everyone smile, then more people will surely come and visit!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
As long as we don't forget that...
Phoenix Wonderland will never die. It will always be able to rise from the ashes!!
se_event_wonders_2021_009

rows.Speaker: Cast & Staff
rows.Line: Making everyone smile...

rows.Speaker: Cast
rows.Line: Since we're doing a show, we should at least strive to do that.

rows.Speaker: Staff
rows.Line: We'll do whatever we can if it means more people come to our rides...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I guess everybody was already on the same page...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (I knew it! I was right...!)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I, Tsukasa Tenma the future star, promise to bring you a magnificent show that can do everything I just said!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: A magnificent show...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (I was right, grandpa! That zingy-zing feeling I got when I saw him during those interviews sent me in the right direction!)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You all work day in and day out to make every guest that visits smile. Surely, we'll be able to put on an incredible performance if we all work together!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But we're gonna have to give it absolutely everything we have until the curtains go up!

rows.Speaker: Cast
rows.Line: Come to think of it, I don't think I've ever seen anyone not smiling after seeing a Wonder Stage show.

rows.Speaker: Cast
rows.Line:
Hehe.
And we're the veterans here. We can't let a kid like him hog all the fun.

rows.Speaker: Cast
rows.Line: Yeah! Let's make this the best show ever!
se_event_wonders_2021_001

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: (All of those who've gathered here today are at the very least of the same mind as me.)

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: (I'm sure that some people were still unsure about what we'd be doing when they first came here...)

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: (But I'm only seeing smiles after hearing that speech...)

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: (Who would've ever thought that pompous oaf had something like that in him.)

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line:
Hehe...
Nicely done.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: The chief director for this operation will be the Wonder Stage's own Rui Kamishiro! The singing and dancing will be led by Sakurako Seiryuin of the Phoenix Stage!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Regarding anything else, feel free to ask me!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Now, let's get this show on the road!!
se_event_wonders_2021_005

rows.Speaker: Director A
rows.Line: What?! I have to go all the way over there right after this part?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes. It's actually doable if you go through the changing rooms here. I've even done so myself.

rows.Speaker: Director B
rows.Line:
About the effect for this part...
What did you have in mind exactly?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We'll be using the drone I made for that. I've been making them for a long time now, so we have quite a few at our disposal.

rows.Speaker: Director B
rows.Line: What? You can make drones, Kamishiro?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Hehe. I needed them for our shows.
Oh, also, what if we did this...?

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line:
Cut!
This scene is all about making dramatic revelations! Your singing needs to pack a much bigger punch than that!

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: I don't care that you're the chorus for Kusanagi. You all need to sing like you're the heroes of this show!

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: I'll be taking a look at the other teams now, Kusanagi. Make sure they get this part down!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Uh, yeah... Okay...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (But... I don't know any of these people... How am I supposed to tell them what to do...?)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I feel more jittery doing this than when I'm on stage... No...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I have to do this... I have to do everything I can right now!!)

rows.Speaker: Cast A
rows.Line: *Sob*... I only heard rumors about her, but Seiryuin's so hard on everyone...

rows.Speaker: Cast B
rows.Line: Would you mind going through that last part again, Kusanagi?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
O-Okay...
C-Can you start from the top?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(Oh, now I get it...!
I can't quite put my finger on it, but it's not quite sending the right message...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(I... I can do this...
I helped Hoshino with her singing so...!)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Um... I have a feeling that you're not singing as well as you usually can... Maybe...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: If you sing more normally, it might actually sound better... I guess...?

rows.Speaker: Cast A
rows.Line:
Our normal voices...?
Okay, we can try that.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: O-Okay. Then let's try that again...

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: They should be just fine in her hands...

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line:
Beep. Of course.
Nene is a songstress after all.

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: Eep!

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line:
Do your best, Nene...
I'll be cheering for you...

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: T-This robot... It was in one of their shows... I didn't know it could talk like this...!

rows.Speaker: Cast A
rows.Line: Excuse me! Can you tell me a little more about this part of the routine?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah! For this part you go right, left, twirly-whirl and bam! Like that!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Who can possibly understand what you just said?!

rows.Speaker: Cast A
rows.Line: Right, left, twirly-whirl and... Oh, I did it!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: How?!

rows.Speaker: Cast B
rows.Line: Sorry! I need some help with where I need to be for this part!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ah, I'll be right there!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Heh heh heh♪
Dancing with this many people is so much fun!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You're right! It feels like we've accomplished something already!

rows.Speaker: Cast
rows.Line: I'm sorry! Do I go left and turn there?!

rows.Speaker: Cast
rows.Line: I need some help with some props...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hold on! Just hold on!
One at a time...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Having to coordinate this many people is starting to take its toll...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But I'm destined to be a star! I'll be dealing with significantly more people than this in the future!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Alright, who's next?! Step right up!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Okay! Next, we need to check on all the rides and attractions that we'll be using for the finale!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
By the way, Emu...
Is “that thing” gonna be ready in time?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yup! Mr. Mascot and the others said that they had some extras in stock, so I got a bunch of them!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Rui and Robo-Nene went all zappy-zap-zap, and modded them for us!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Great, I can't wait to see them!
We'll actually be able to see a spell be cast over all of Phoenix Wonderland!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But how did you come up with this idea in the first place, Emu?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe♪ It's awesome, right?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Actually, it sort of has to do with how I don't like it when the sun sets...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hm? Why's that?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Because it always feels like a super fun day is about to end. That's why I thought it would be awesome to have things be just as sparkly and fun at night!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: And that's just one of my ideas!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: And I would expect no less from you, Emu...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Don't worry! I promise to make the night after our show ends as sparkly, fun and full of laughter as it can possibly be!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Um, Tsukasa...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Thank you... Thank you so much for doing this!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hah! There's no need to thank me!
I'm a future star! This is the least I can do for you!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Now, let's go!
We still have a mountain of work left to do!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (For the longest time, I was so scared...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (I wasn't sure if it was okay for me to try and keep the promise I made with grandpa. To make Phoenix Wonderland a place where everyone can smile.)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (But everyone helped me realize that all these people feel the same way.)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (That's why...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: We have to absolutely, one-million-percent make this a great, big success!!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Emu, calm down!
Quit yelling and go help the other teams!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yes, sir!!
